data.summary: MEServiceNow Developer | CSA & CAD Certified | 3.5+ Years of ExperienceServiceNow Developer with 3.5+ years of hands-on experience in ServiceNow Development, Administration, andITSM implementations. Skilled in Incident, Problem, Change, SLA, CMDB, Service Catalog, and KnowledgeManagement aligned with ITIL best practices. Strong expertise in JavaScript, Glide API, Business Rules, Client Scripts,Script Includes, UI Policies, UI Actions, ACLs, and Flow Designer for workflow automation and platform customization.Experienced in REST API integrations, Scripted REST APIs, Import Sets, Transform Maps, Update Set deployments, andService Catalog development. Proven ability to automate business processes, improve operational efficiency,reduce manual effort, and deliver scalable, secure, and business-aligned ServiceNow solutions in Agileenvironments.

raw_sections.experience:
SERVICENOW DEVELOPER
WORK EXPERIENCESERVICENOW DEVELOPER | HCLTechSep 2022 – Present | Hyderabad
Developed and customized Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies,UI Actions, and Script Includes for business process automation andplatform customization.
Worked extensively on ITSM modules including Incident, Problem,Change, SLA, CMDB, Service Catalog, and Knowledge Managementaligned with ITIL best practices.
Implemented REST APIs, Scripted REST APIs, Import Sets, andTransform Maps for integrations, data migration, and seamlesscommunication with external systems.
Created Catalog Items, Record Producers, Order Guides,Notifications, Reports, and Dashboards to improve operationalefficiency and user experience.
Managed users, groups, roles, ACLs, Update Sets, deployments, andproduction support activities across multiple ServiceNowenvironments.
Worked extensively with GlideRecord and GlideAjax scripting todevelop reusable and efficient server-side solutions.
Configured inbound email actions, SLA workflows, scheduled jobs,and automated notifications based on business requirements.
Participated in requirement gathering, Agile ceremonies, UATsupport, troubleshooting, and post-deployment validation to ensuresmooth project delivery and customer satisfaction.
Developed and maintained Service Catalog Items, Record Producers,and Order Guides to streamline request fulfillment processes.
Created and configured Reports and Dashboards to monitor SLAcompliance, ticket trends, and operational KPIs.
Supported data import activities using Data Sources, Import Sets,and Transform Maps while ensuring data accuracy and integrity.
